+  clauses ``[ -x,  y,  z]`` and ``[ -y, -z, -x]``.  These two clauses are

+  gadget uses three distinct variables per clause, it respects the target
+  format.

+of auxiliary variables introduced, which is polynomial.
+"""

+    itself and a negative sign denotes its negation.

+    """Add clauses that force ``var`` to be assigned False.
+    The construction uses two fresh auxiliary variables ``y`` and ``z`` and
+    adds the clauses ``[-var, y, z]`` and ``[-y, -z, -var]``.  These clauses
+    are satisfied only when ``var`` is False.
